package_name: Parvati Valley Trek Expedition (5D) — Kheerganga & Hot Springs

itinerary.day_1: Bhuntar → Kasol (Drive: 35 km). Places: Kasol, Chalal. Activities: Kasol orientation; Chalal village hike; Riverside café dinner.
itinerary.day_2: Manikaran → Tosh (Drive: 25 km). Places: Manikaran Sahib, Tosh. Activities: Manikaran hot spring; Drive to Barshaini; Tosh overnight (2,400m).
itinerary.day_3: Barshaini → Kheerganga (Drive: Trek 12km). Places: Kheerganga Trek. Activities: Pine forests & waterfalls; Natural hot spring (2,960m); Overnight camping.
itinerary.day_4: Kheerganga → Kasol (Drive: Trek down). Places: Kalga, Pulga, Kasol. Activities: Morning descent; Kalga & Pulga; Kasol rest.
itinerary.day_5: Kasol → Bhuntar (Drive: 35 km). Places: Manikaran Sahib. Activities: Manikaran morning visit; Depart via Kullu.
